title: Minethon API
description: API for commands, Datapacks and more!
body:
# MINETHON
Minethon API is a Neoforge Mod that provides new commands for Datapack creators or Commands users in general. Providing multiple features such as:
- Raycasting
- Flight toggling
- Right Click simulation
- Block interactions
and much more.

###   Things you should know
- Mod is still very much in development, issues and lack of features are to be expected.
- Does not provide any content on its own.
- Meant to be used in Datapacks, not Mods.

### For More details, visit the Wiki Page:
[https://github.com/Deltalation/Minethon-API/wiki](https://github.com/Deltalation/Minethon-API/wiki)
